summary: Documentation only: the operator accepts ADR-0048 (final HTTPS destinations for cloud providers) and ADR-0049 (resume bounded full reviews across scheduled runs), both merged as proposed. Each ADR gets status accepted, date 2026-11-08, decision-maker operator and one closing sentence; the decision text is unchanged. The ADR index follows. The CHANGELOG links the published v0.25.2 release in its table row (date of release 2026-11-08, ADR-0048 referenced) and labels the development-tooling section as included in v0.25.2, with a stray blank-line pair removed. No code, workflow, checker, skill, threat model, register or configuration change.
limitations: ADR-0049's ledger has not yet run on a scheduled full review; the first weekly run after the merge of #81 is due on 2026-11-09.
